They were translated into English by the same Venerable monk, presently residing at Potkulkala Forest Hermitage in Khandagedra Devalagam.

A certain magician is going to hold a magic show in some hall or theatre.
Among those who have come to see the magic show, there is a whitey person with the wisdom eye who tells himself,
Today I must see the magic show inside out.
With this determination, he hides himself in a corner of the stage, unseen by others.
When the magic show starts, this person begins to discover, before long, the secrets of the magician,
his deceitful stock-in-trade counterfeits, hidden strings and buttons,
secret pockets and false buttons in his magic boxes.

In this vision, he comes to the conclusion that there is no magic in any of those gadgets.
